meta.objective: Investigate the currently surfaced V3 stability blockers across Temporal runtime, Convex cleanup semantics, reset/control-plane behavior, and observability so the next relaunch has a sharply reduced need for manual intervention.

decisions.summary: Use the workflow as a pre-relaunch stability program rather than launching another V3 pass immediately.
decisions.rationale: The current surfaced blockers split into at least two families: Temporal preflight liveness and Convex cleanup/reset semantics. They should be separated and ranked before the next live loop.
